item.title: [No Priors] Frontier Chips for Frontier AI Labs, with Walter Goodwin, Founder/CEO of Fractile
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:30 Right now, we're trying to build a single chip. If you crack open an NVIDIA system, it has anywhere between kind of six and nine custom chips all built by NVIDIA to come together to build something that is really, really potent. So there's already a gap there. You know, it'd be great to be productive enough that we could start to build our own responses in that same kind of way. This idea of being able to have at any given moment a kind of rolling frontier of bets that ...
